plans.idea: Faithful centered story stack like the original: logo crown, large hero, then headline/subhead, the NEW + LIMITED RUN badge pair right under the copy, and a wide CTA closing the column on one shared centre axis.

Headline-first: big one-line headline and subhead lead under the logo, badges grouped directly beneath the copy, then a large centered hero and the CTA anchoring the bottom so the eye goes message, product, action.

Header bar plus dominant hero: badges top-left and logo top-right share one top edge, a near-full-width bottle fills the upper half, and the headline block with a centered CTA sits in the lower third.
